Invariance of the nonnegative quadrant and Nprime=A-dS-rho I<=A-dN bounds every trajectory. The critical positive-equilibrium equation is proportional to I^2, excluding any interior equilibrium; an interior periodic orbit would enclose one, contradicting its index. Planar compact omega-limit analysis plus local attracting E0 gives global convergence. Strong stable manifold lies on I=0, so interior trajectories have center asymptotics. From W=I^-2, Wprime=2c-2q I+O(I^2), integration and inversion yield the explicit two terms and O(t^-3/2 log t), including S via the graph. Boundary solutions decay exponentially, and no interior formula is claimed there.
